name: matthewtoghill-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code mods by Matthew Toghill: next-step suggestions, session file-change replay and on-demand test runs

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: After each turn, Haiku suggests 1-4 next steps above the prompt; picking one drafts its prompt without sending it

plugins.name: session-replay
plugins.description: Step through, replay and restore every file change made in this session, grouped by prompt

plugins.name: test-watch
plugins.description: A band above the prompt tracks files changed since the last test run; run the tests on demand and draft a fix prompt from the failures
